about: The project bench/app-mode/run.mjs scans when no --project is given: an npm project at the root and a Cargo sub-project in svc/, public package names at versions with published advisories. Kept as JSON and written to a temp folder at run time, so no lockfile with known advisories sits in this repository for scanners to report, and no server run writes beside the repository's files.
